inputs.command:
set -u; db_user="$(sed -n 's/^POSTGRES_USER=//p' .env 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; db_name="$(sed -n 's/^POSTGRES_DB=//p' .env 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; db_user="${db_user:-madworld}"; db_name="${db_name:-madworld_db}"; printf '%s
' SCHEMA_AUDIT_START; date -u +%FT%TZ; hostname; id -u; printf '%s
' --DEPLOYED--; cat /opt/madworld/.github-deployed-sha 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' --ENV_PRESENCE--; for k in MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL POSTGRES_USER POSTGRES_DB POSTGRES_PASSWORD DB_HOST_PORT; do if grep -qE "^${k}=" .env 2>/dev/null; then echo ${k}=set-in-dotenv; else echo ${k}=absent-from-dotenv; fi; done; printf '%s
' --COMPOSE_PS--; docker compose --env-file .env -f ops/docker-compose.production.yml -f ops/docker-compose.deploy.yml ps 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' --POSTGRES_STATE--; docker inspect madworld-postgres-1 --format 'image={{.Config.Image}} state={{.State.Status}} health={{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}' 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' --DATABASES--; timeout 20 docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U "$db_user" -Atc "SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datistemplate=false ORDER BY datname;" 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' --ABUSE_TABLES--; timeout 20 docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U "$db_user" -d "$db_name" -Atc "SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename LIKE 'abuse_control_%' ORDER BY tablename;" 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' --SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS--; timeout 20 docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U "$db_user" -d "$db_name" -Atc "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='schema_migrations';" 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' --MIGRATION_COUNT--; timeout 20 docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U "$db_user" -d "$db_name" -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM schema_migrations;" 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' SCHEMA_AUDIT_DONE
